Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Join activities on activities.activity_id = activities.activity_id
Join assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Filter target_dictionary.tid = 1861
Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Filter activities.type = 'IC50'
Order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
Limit 1000
